title: Koala Fingerprints Look Almost Exactly Like Ours
description: Koalas have fingerprints so similar to human ones that they are hard to tell apart, even under a microscope.

scenes.text: Koalas have fingerprints. And they look almost exactly like ours.
They have the same loops, arches and swirls that we have on our fingertips.
Scientists have said that even under a microscope, koala prints can be very hard to tell apart from human ones.
Koalas are not close relatives of ours. Their prints probably developed to help them grip branches and handle their leafy food.
Nature sometimes solves the same problem twice. Follow for more weird facts.
